item.title: Day 10 without power in Gary Indiana
item.description:
Honestly got lucky. The empty house next to me doesn't have a roof anymore.
Some damage, lots of debris
Insurance doesn't want to cover removing this tulip poplar because it didn't actually fall yet. But when it does it's going to hit the house, so that's fun.
It looks like this everywhere
On Monday, workers hooked my main power line back up. But they didn't actually check anything because if they did, they would have seen that the meter wasn't registering any voltage. There's a damaged wire in my weatherhead that's causing the hot to arc into the ground. It took them FOUR DAYS to come back and turn the power off at the pole so I can get an electrician to come repair it. I had ungrounded power running through my house even with the main breaker off. I think my fourth phone call, yelling about how I got shocked trying to take a shower did the trick. Luckily insurance is covering house repairs and electrician costs, but I'm running low on supplies. Candles, toilet paper, etc. There are no stores in my neighborhood that have power where people can buy stuff. If you can spare a few dollars to help me order supplies, I would so much appreciate it. Thank you https://ko-fi.com/shineystar
